# Upstream provenance

This directory is the minimal Pi Package distribution of
[obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers), retained under its MIT
license.

- Tag: `v6.2.0`
- Commit: `3dcbd5c4b48e02263fbf4a3c01e3fe4f81d584d9`
- Release date: 2026-07-24

It contains the upstream `skills/`, Pi extension, package metadata, assets,
README, and license. BrainPilot adds only `manifest.json`, this provenance note,
and `.brainpilot/source.json` for installation and runtime projection.
